what: ASE Technology is the world's largest provider of semiconductor packaging and testing. Chipmakers send finished wafers to its plants, where they are cut, packaged into usable chips, tested and shipped. It also assembles electronic modules for customers.
customers: Chip designers and foundries, including most of the large fabless companies, plus electronics manufacturers.
money: packaging and testing services for semiconductor makers
moat: Scale and advanced packaging capability at a point in the chip supply chain where only a few companies can serve the largest customers.
risks: Gross margin of about 18% is thin because the business is capital-heavy
Chip demand is cyclical and packaging orders move with it
Debt of about $12 billion against $3 billion of cash
opportunities: AI chips need advanced packaging, the fastest-growing and highest-margin part of its work
Analysts see large upside, though coverage is thin with only two estimates
watch: Advanced packaging revenue and utilisation rates at its plants.
